title: Composite Place - a transform gizmo that scales and positions an image ON TOP of the current entry
description: BLOCKED BY MPI-377. Third composite front end: the slot image sits ON TOP of the selected entry, moved / scaled / rotated by a gizmo with handles like the shape gizmo, then flattened into a new history entry. Cut-out object from another generation or a photo, dropped onto an existing image, then detailed to blend.
acceptance: A third composite tool (placeComp) sits in the Composite toolbar group and opens with the slot image drawn on top of the selected entry, scaled to fit and centred
A gizmo with the shape gizmo's handle set moves, scales and rotates the placed image; SHIFT locks its aspect ratio and ALT scales about the centre, same as MpiToolOptionsShapes
The placed image keeps its own alpha - a background-removed PNG shows the entry through its transparent pixels, with no mask involved
Apply writes ONE new history entry at the base entry's full resolution; both sources are untouched
Leaving the tool restores the single-entry canvas and writes nothing to disk (the preview contract in docs/masking-tools.md)
Undo / redo covers a placement the same way a shape commit is covered
The tool is dead-gated, not silent: no slot image = the Apply button renders disabled with a hint, never a click that swallows itself
